description: champion-hq: bodies for summoned units. UCireChampionArt looks up 'summon:<id>' (id = the summon's HeroName in snake case: oathbound_guardian, spectral_companion, mechanical_tank) before the summon's gameplay profile. Rows use the ChampionArtBindings 'ready' shape (mesh, locomotion, attack, heightCm, optional yaw / fallback). A missing or non-ready row keeps the previous body. Written by Tools/WriteChampionHQBindings.py.

summons.note: champion-hq HQ summon body; no row = the summon's archetype body
